statBlock.name: Thought Spy
statBlock.description: House Dimir trains these infiltrators to use mental magic alongside mundane disguise and stealth.

sections.Bonus actions: Cunning Action. On its turn, the spy can Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.
sections.Innate Spellcasting (Psionics):
Intelligence (spell save DC 13), with no components.
At will. Charm Person, Disguise Self, Encode Thoughts.
1/day each. Blur, Detect Thoughts, Gaseous Form.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks or three ranged Dagger attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Trostani
statBlock.description: Three dryads share the body and life force of the Selesnya guildmaster. They embody order, life, and harmony and usually speak as one from their home in Vitu-Ghazi.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Trostani can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Trostani has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Her weapon attacks are magical.
Speak with Beasts and Plants. She can communicate with beasts and plants as if they share a language.
Tree Stride. Once on her turn, spend 10 ft. of movement to magically enter a living tree within reach and emerge in an open space within 5 ft. of a second living tree. The trees must both be Large or larger and within 60 ft. of each other.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Wisdom (spell save DC 24), with no material components.
At will. Dispel Magic, Druidcraft.
3/day each. Bless, Conjure Animals, Giant Insect, Moonbeam, Plant Growth, Spike Growth, Suggestion.
1/day each. Conjure Fey, Mass Cure Wounds.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Constrict, use Touch of Order, and cast one spell with a casting time of 1 action.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. The creature is grappled (escape DC 19) and restrained until that grapple ends. Trostani can hold up to three targets at once.
Touch of Order. Melee spell attack, +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 23 (3d8 + 10) radiant damage. Trostani can suppress the magic of one visible magic item in the target’s possession until her next turn starts. Artifacts are exempt.
Wrath of Mat’Selesnya (Recharge 5–6). Choose a visible point within 60 ft. Each creature in the 30-ft. cube there makes a DC 24 Dexterity save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) bludgeoning plus 21 (6d6) slashing damage. Success halves both.
sections.Legendary actions:
The creature can spend up to three legendary actions, choosing one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.
Voice of Harmony (1 action). Make one melee attack with advantage.
Voice of Life (1 action). Grant 20 temporary HP to another visible creature within 120 ft.
Voice of Order (1 action). Cast Dispel Magic.
Chorus of the Conclave (2 actions). Cast Suggestion, spending a daily use.
Awaken Grove Guardians (3 actions). One or two visible trees within 120 ft. uproot and become Awakened Trees for 1 minute or until Trostani ends the effect as a bonus action. They understand Druidic and follow her spoken orders. They cannot speak. In the absence of orders they follow her and Dodge.
sections.Source notes: The print pairs Strength 19 with a +5 modifier. This profile keeps the printed score and Constrict numbers. The usual modifier for Strength 19 is +4.
sections.Roleplaying: Trostani wants every community to join the Conclave. She takes a member’s departure as a betrayal. Her three personalities disagree over how to meet Ravnica’s rising tensions. See p. 251.

statBlock.name: Undercity Medusa
statBlock.description: Ravnica’s gorgons have writhing cables for hair and clawed hands. Their gaze petrifies when they choose to use it.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The medusa has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Surprise Attack. In the first round, it attacks surprised creatures with advantage and deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage each time one of those attacks hits.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence (spell save DC 14), with no material components.
1/day each. Expeditious Retreat, Fog Cloud, Misty Step.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. The medusa can also use Petrifying Gaze before or after the pair.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Petrifying Gaze. Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. that can see the medusa’s eyes. It makes a DC 14 Constitution save. Failure by 5 or more petrifies it immediately. Any other failure restrains it as it turns to stone. A restrained creature repeats the save at the end of its next turn. Failure petrifies it and success ends the effect. Greater Restoration or similar magic ends the petrification.
sections.Golgari lair rules: An Undercity Medusa can qualify a group of six or more Golgari for the shared lair actions on p. 236 while they defend their territory. See Golgari Shaman for the actions and regional effects.
sections.Named example: Ludmilla, the Tunnel Viper, survived the other Sisters of Stone Death. She keeps her petrified victims in the undercity and plots against Jarad Vod Savo.

statBlock.name: Wurm
statBlock.description: A limbless, wingless burrower that liquefies loose soil with vibrations. The Gruul sometimes lure it toward settled districts.

sections.Traits:
Earth Tremors. When a creature first comes within 30 ft. of the moving wurm on a turn, it makes a DC 20 Dexterity save. Failure deals 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and knocks it prone. A ground-anchored object or structure that first comes within the same distance on a turn takes 10 (3d6) force damage.
Siege Monster. The wurm deals double damage to objects and structures.
Tunneler. The wurm burrows through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 10-ft.-diameter tunnel.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 24 (5d6 + 7) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit must pass a DC 20 Dexterity save or be swallowed. It is blinded and restrained inside, has total cover from external attacks and effects, and takes 17 (5d6) acid damage at the start of each of the wurm’s turns. If a creature inside deals 30 or more damage to the wurm in one turn, the wurm makes a DC 21 Constitution save at that turn’s end. On a failure it regurgitates all swallowed creatures, which land prone within 10 ft. When the wurm dies, swallowed creatures are no longer restrained by it. They can spend 20 ft. of movement to exit prone.

statBlock.name: Zegana
statBlock.description: The Simic Combine’s Prime Speaker defends the guild’s traditions and keeps her post with the support of the Speakers’ Chamber.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Zegana breathes air and water.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). She can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. She has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Spellcasting:
Zegana is a 15th-level Simic spellcaster with prepared wizard spells. Intelligence sets spell save DC 18 and +10 to hit with spell attacks.
Cantrips (at will). Acid Splash, Druidcraft, Ray of Frost, Shape Water.
1st level (4 slots). Color Spray, Expeditious Retreat, Fog Cloud, Shield.
2nd level (3 slots). Enlarge/Reduce, Gust of Wind.
3rd level (3 slots). Counterspell, Fly, Slow.
4th level (3 slots). Control Water, Ice Storm, Polymorph.
5th level (2 slots). Conjure Elemental, Creation.
6th level (1 slot). Move Earth, Wall of Ice.
7th level (1 slot). Prismatic Spray, Teleport.
8th level (1 slot). Control Weather, Dominate Monster.
sections.Actions:
Prime Speaker’s Trident. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage and the trident booms. Each creature in a 15-ft. cube from its prongs makes a DC 18 Constitution save. Failure deals 9 (2d8) thunder damage, or 13 (3d8) to a creature underwater, and pushes the creature 10 ft. away from Zegana. Success halves the thunder damage and prevents the push.
Deluge (Recharge 4–6). Send a wave to an area within 120 ft., up to 30 ft. long, 10 ft. wide, and 10 ft. high. Each creature there makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and knocks it prone. Success halves the damage and prevents the knockdown. The water puts out unprotected flames it touches before vanishing.
sections.Legendary actions:
The creature can spend up to three legendary actions, choosing one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.
Adaptive Skin (1 action). Gain resistance to acid, fire, lightning, or thunder damage until her next turn starts.
Trident (1 action). Make one melee attack with the Prime Speaker’s Trident.
Enlarge (2 actions). Cast Enlarge/Reduce on herself using Enlarge without spending a spell slot.
Deluge (3 actions). Use Deluge if available.
sections.Roleplaying: Zegana treats nature’s patterns as a guide for improving life. She commits her resources to Ravnica and struggles to understand anyone who rejects progress. See p. 254.
